note: Drills executed by subagents in isolated worktrees; blast radius + green status re-measured by orchestrator via git diff and a re-run of all 5 checks (lint/typecheck/depcruise/tests/verify:enforcement all exit 0 in every worktree). No rule-bypass escape hatch (disable comment / any / boundary bypass) in any drill.

drills.drill: Delete Vue (core/ compiles + tests without vue/DOM)
drills.actual: core compiles (tsc types:[]), 17/17 core tests pass with vue/pinia/router stubbed to throw + env=node; core reaches only @shared/lib/result (framework-free)

drills.drill: Reshape every DTO (casing + nesting + enum repr)
drills.predicted: data/ only; fails if ui/ or core/ changes
drills.actual: 6 data/ files + 1 data-level test. ZERO core/ or ui/ changes. +194/-163 lines.
drills.verdict: PASS — perfect containment; the DTO/mapper seam absorbed casing+nesting+enum changes with core and ui untouched

drills.predicted: the two slices; fails if it drags unrelated imports
drills.actual: 4 files, +12/-3. FAILS-AS-PREDICTED: the badge dragged billing's InvoiceStatus type into scheduling (imported via @slices/billing), billing's own views now consume it back through @slices/scheduling, and depcruise no-circular fired on the billing<->scheduling cycle until routed through public indexes. Small blast radius but boundary-crossing.
drills.verdict: INFORMATIVE FAIL — demonstrates rule 5 (a component belongs to the slice it is ABOUT). The architecture correctly makes a domain-wrong move painful (cycle risk + cross-slice back-import). It is NOT a cheap/clean move because the move is semantically wrong.

drills.predicted: those slices + one route registration; fails if any other slice or app view changes
drills.actual: new invoicing slice + billing edits + app/router + app/providers/msw.ts + the slices-array registration. app/views/ClientOverviewView.vue UNCHANGED (billing kept the app-consumed fetchUnpaidInvoiceSummaries). dto.ts + mappers.ts had to be DUPLICATED into invoicing (dtos-stay-home forbids cross-slice sharing).
drills.verdict: PARTIAL — contained to the two slices + composition root (router+msw are legitimate composition edits) + the sanctioned slice-registration config edit; app VIEWS untouched as predicted. Real costs surfaced: (1) any new slice requires a CODEOWNERS-gated architecture.config.ts edit (by design), (2) DTO/mapper code must be duplicated across the split because they can never be shared.
drills.escape_hatch: none (rule-bypass); architecture.config.ts slices-array edit is the documented, review-gated mechanism for adding a slice, not a bypass

drills.predicted: one data/ folder; fails if any ui/ signature changes
drills.actual: data/ swap + app/main.ts + package.json + ui internal change. useInvoiceList's PUBLIC signature (InvoiceListState) UNCHANGED — predicted failure condition did NOT trigger.
drills.verdict: PARTIAL-PASS — ui public signature held (the key claim), but the store's Pinia-ness leaked into ui (useInvoiceList used pinia's storeToRefs, so its internals had to change), and removing pinia forced app/main.ts + package.json edits. Not literally 'one data/ folder'.
